${ModID}:BlackKnife.NAME: Black Knife
${ModID}:BlackKnife.FLAVOR: You can summon hundreds of these without breaking a sweat.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your first #b3 turns each combat, add a #yStar into your hand.

${ModID}:WiffleBat.NAME: Wiffle Bat
${ModID}:WiffleBat.FLAVOR: You feel nostalgic looking at this.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, apply #y${ModID}:Swoon to a random enemy.

${ModID}:EnhancedBlade.NAME: Enhanced Blade
${ModID}:EnhancedBlade.FLAVOR: You've made many Dark Fountains with this blade.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you play a #y${ModID}:Titan card each combat, gain #b1 #yStrength, #b1 #yDexterity, and #b8 #yBlock.

${ModID}:VisorManipulator.NAME: Visor Manipulator
${ModID}:VisorManipulator.FLAVOR: Gives you clearer vision, allowing you to hurt them that much harder.
DESCRIPTIONS: Raise your max hand size by #b2. At the start of each combat, add #b2 #yStars into your hand.

${ModID}:SheerAura.NAME: Sheer Aura
${ModID}:SheerAura.FLAVOR: These enemies can't hurt you. Time to aura farm them.
DESCRIPTIONS: #y${ModID}:Paralyzed enemies deal #b60% less damage rather than #b40%.

${ModID}:TitanFragment.NAME: Titan Fragment
${ModID}:TitanFragment.FLAVOR: You will finish what they started.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, add a #yShadow #ySerpent with #yRetain into your hand. It costs #b0 this combat.

${ModID}:BlackHole.NAME: Black Hole
${ModID}:BlackHole.FLAVOR: Your power keeps this under control. It does only what you need it to.
DESCRIPTIONS: The first time you #y${ModID}:Warp each turn, you choose which card gets returned.

${ModID}:Synchronizer.NAME: Synchronizer
${ModID}:Synchronizer.FLAVOR: It hums at the same distorted frequency as you.
DESCRIPTIONS: Whenever an enemy applies #yWeak, #yVulnerable, or #yStrength #yDown to you, they also gain that debuff.

${ModID}:SOULKnife.NAME: SOUL Knife
${ModID}:SOULKnife.FLAVOR: One of your many knives, now infused with the power of a SOUL.
DESCRIPTIONS: Replaces [#800080]Black[] [#800080]Knife[]. At the start of your turn, add a #yStar into your hand. #yStars deal #b3 more damage.

${ModID}:WhiteHole.NAME: White Hole
${ModID}:WhiteHole.FLAVOR: One half of a pair, just like you and... no, never mind.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of your turn, #y${ModID}:Warp and gain #b6 #yBlock.

${ModID}:Sanctuary.NAME: Sanctuary
${ModID}:Sanctuary.FLAVOR: It's what you seek... but also what you want to destroy.
DESCRIPTIONS: At the start of each combat, add #b2 #yProphecies into your hand.
